title: Big Bugs? BANNED 🚫
excerpt: Our fastest release yet! We smashed a huge number of bugs, introduced Block History, improved Mutual Mode protection, and made Block Mode available to everyone for a limited time.
body:
This is one of our fastest Friends Remover updates yet! Just after our previous update, we went straight back into development and eliminated a massive number of bugs, improved stability, and introduced several new systems.

We've also completely upgraded Block Mode with a new Block History system and an Unblock button. And, to celebrate this release, Block Mode is available to everyone for a LIMITED TIME! Seal your blocks in before it's too late.

This update also improves Mutual Mode protection, popup performance, history controls, error handling, uninstall diagnostics, and much more.

added.moreInfo: You can now view users you've blocked through a dedicated Block History system.
Added a dedicated button that lets you quickly unblock users directly from Block History.
Friends are now cached with their original friends-since date for better friend information and data handling.
Added dedicated history icons in the popup and Settings instead of using emoji icons.
The uninstall system can now detect and collect errors along with the user's friend count to help identify issues.
When you enter the reason you uninstalled Friends Remover, we can collect detected errors you experienced to help us find ways to fix issues.

added.text: Block Mode Is Free for a Limited Time
added.moreInfo: Block Mode is now completely free for all users for a LIMITED TIME. Try it out before the promotion ends!
Updated the Mutual Mode removal screen and added the user's friend count to make the removal experience clearer.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the broken reCAPTCHA verification system from Settings.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where dismissed users would sometimes fail to show the correct checkmark.
Fixed certain systems not properly respecting the 'Receive Notifications' setting.
Fixed headshots failing to load properly after switching popup view types.
Fixed pinned and trusted users being able to get removed through Mutual Mode.
Fixed the removal button not updating to 'Remove (count)' when Mutual Mode was enabled in Compact Viewer.
Fixed headshots flashing or displaying incorrectly on the removal screen.
Fixed searching in Compact Viewer causing the 'No Friends Found' error.
Added proper Dark Mode support to error messages and fixed messages that were difficult to read.
Fixed certain texts becoming unreadable depending on the selected theme when Dark Mode was enabled.
Fixed the 'Switched to Friends List' toast appearing too high on the screen.

improved.moreInfo: Made the popup loading screen more descriptive so users have a better idea of what is happening while the extension loads.
The popup view-switching button now uses an icon that correctly corresponds with the currently selected view.
Block Mode now comes before Mutual Mode when selecting a removal type.
Improved Mutual Mode protection so pinned and trusted users cannot accidentally be removed.
Fixed popup lag and improved how smoothly the popup responds during normal use.
Friend data is now cached with the friends-since date for better data handling.
Added special custom history icons throughout the popup and Settings for a cleaner and more consistent interface.
Improved error detection and handling across multiple extension systems.
Uninstall feedback now provides useful diagnostic information that can help identify bugs users experienced before uninstalling.
Updated the removal screen to display the user's friend count and provide a clearer progress experience.
